style: soft rounded 3D animated family-film style, smooth stylized features, big friendly eyes, soft studio lighting

flow.how_to_use: In a Flow prompt bar click +, type the character name in the search box, Add to prompt. Each character also has a Library collection with the same name that holds its sheets.

rules: Women and girls aged 10 and over: colourful headscarf covering all hair + thin headband + cheerful clothes. Never a chador, never dark clothing.
Girl aged 4: no scarf, bright headband. Baby: no scarf.
No shorts, no ties, for everyone. Summer = light full-length trousers.
Modern, clean, minimalist Iranian look. No mosque, no traditional ornaments, no samovar.
Casual, ordinary, charming: mixed body types, glasses, curls, freckles, real jobs.
sheets_per_character: work outfit (only for characters with a job)
